Options

6 seconds to draw. Standard shape tolerance.

Changes save on this device. Spell directions stay the same for either hand.

Credits

Wizard Combat

A local camera game built around deliberate hand movements.

Created by

Emil Vakhitov and Sofia

Sound & type

Original menu sound effects, released under CC0. Drawing sound adapted from a CC0 recording by Rising_Moon. Spell sounds adapted from CC0 packs by Lentikula, rubberduck, qubodup, and Kenney. Damage sound adapted from a CC0 pack by Kenney. Victory fanfare adapted from a CC0 recording by Spring Spring. Cormorant Garamond and Source Sans 3, licensed under the SIL Open Font License.

Thanks & licenses

Hand tracking by MediaPipe (Apache 2.0). Gesture recognition includes the $P recognizer (BSD).

Font notices: Cormorant Garamond and Source Sans 3.

Camera images and video are not saved. Training saves result and lesson records. Fight also saves captured path drawings.

The camera follows your hand, not the wand tip. Select Knuckles when you hold a wand. Camera and lesson controls are separate. Progress stays when you return to the menu or stop the camera. Reloading the page clears it.
